#FPLIVE: #China is currently facing a surge in cases of Human #Metapneumovirus (#HMPV), a respiratory virus that causes flu-like symptoms. This increase comes five years after the #COVID-19 #pandemic, and reports suggest the virus is spreading rapidly.
